<!doctype html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
  <style>html{background:#000}</style>
  <script>window.__nxBootHold = true;</script>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <title>NEXUS</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #02050d;
      --panel: rgba(8, 18, 34, 0.74);
      --panel-strong: rgba(13, 28, 48, 0.92);
      --line: rgba(92, 202, 255, 0.24);
      --cyan: #53d7ff;
      --cyan-dim: #2b7f9c;
      --gold: #ffbf3d;
      --gold-soft: rgba(255, 190, 61, 0.18);
      --text: #edf7ff;
      --muted: #91a6bd;
      --danger: #ff786f;
      --ok: #43e6a8;
      color-scheme: dark;
      font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", "Yu Gothic UI", "Hiragino Sans", Meiryo, sans-serif;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, rgba(23, 96, 138, 0.2), transparent 36%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 20% 18%, rgba(255, 190, 61, 0.08), transparent 30%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #01030a 0%, #03101d 54%, #01030a 100%);
      color: var(--text);
    }

    canvas#particles {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      opacity: 0.58;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .app {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
      padding: 26px clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 28px) 18px;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .mark {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.44);
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(22, 107, 139, 0.76), rgba(4, 28, 48, 0.86));
      box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.26), inset 0 0 20px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.18);
      color: #96f0ff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 1.9vw, 1.8rem);
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .sub {
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--cyan);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
    }

    .status-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.32);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      background: rgba(4, 18, 34, 0.78);
      color: #cfefff;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .dot {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--ok);
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--ok);
    }

    .main {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 0.95fr) minmax(270px, 360px) minmax(220px, 292px);
      gap: clamp(10px, 1.6vw, 20px);
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 0;
    }

    .app.task-hidden .main {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 1fr) minmax(320px, 430px);
    }

    .holo-wrap {
      min-height: 420px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      position: relative;
    }

    .holo {
      position: relative;
      width: min(46vw, 500px);
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      perspective: 720px;
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 32px rgba(255, 186, 50, 0.22));
      animation: solarDrift 13s ease-in-out infinite;
      transition: filter 260ms ease;
    }

    .holo::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .holo::before {
      inset: 2%;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.24);
      box-shadow: 0 0 44px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.16), inset 0 0 42px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.08);
      animation: auraBreathe 5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .holo.speaking {
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 54px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.56));
      transform: scale(1.035);
      animation: nexusReply 920ms ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .holo.speaking .ring {
      border-color: rgba(255, 222, 120, 0.76);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 34px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.22), 0 0 44px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.28);
      animation-duration: 7s;
    }

    .holo.speaking .ring:nth-child(2) {
      border-color: rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.62);
      animation-duration: 9s;
    }

    .holo.speaking .orb {
      animation: replyPulse 720ms ease-in-out infinite;
      box-shadow: 0 0 82px rgba(255, 62, 42, 0.74), 0 0 42px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.48), 0 0 24px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.32), inset 0 0 58px rgba(255, 244, 176, 0.36);
    }

    .holo.core-trail .orb {
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(255, 182, 70, 0.52)) drop-shadow(0 0 44px rgba(255, 76, 32, 0.28));
    }

    .holo.core-trail .orb::before {
      inset: -8%;
      border-color: rgba(255, 226, 150, 0.32);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 44% 48%, rgba(255, 235, 140, 0.18), transparent 36%),
        conic-gradient(from 18deg, transparent 0 42%, rgba(255, 120, 36, 0.32) 50%, rgba(255, 224, 128, 0.20) 57%, transparent 66% 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 34px rgba(255, 170, 62, 0.34), 0 0 72px rgba(255, 72, 32, 0.22);
      opacity: 0;
      animation: coreAfterimage 2.3s ease-out 1;
    }

    .holo.speaking .scan {
      height: 3px;
      opacity: 1;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.72), rgba(255, 226, 130, 0.95), transparent);
      animation-duration: 1.2s;
    }

    .satellite {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      z-index: 8;
      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #fff2d4, #ff4a2e 38%, rgba(255, 40, 24, 0.08) 72%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255, 74, 46, 0.88), 0 0 34px rgba(255, 46, 30, 0.34);
      transform-origin: 0 0;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      animation: satelliteOrbitA 9.6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .satellite:nth-of-type(8) {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      opacity: 0.72;
      animation-name: satelliteOrbitB;
      animation-duration: 13.2s;
      animation-delay: -4.2s;
    }

    .satellite:nth-of-type(9) {
      width: 11px;
      height: 11px;
      opacity: 0.82;
      animation-name: satelliteOrbitC;
      animation-duration: 16.8s;
      animation-delay: -7.5s;
    }

    .ring {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 16%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      z-index: 6;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 226, 142, 0.68);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 24px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.14), 0 0 24px rgba(255, 188, 52, 0.34), 0 0 4px rgba(255, 249, 205, 0.86);
      transform-origin: 50% 50%;
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      animation: orbitRingA 18s linear infinite;
    }

    .ring::before,
    .ring::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: -5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      transform-origin: 50% 50%;
    }

    .ring::before {
      background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 0 72%, rgba(255, 252, 208, 0.98) 79%, rgba(255, 169, 42, 0.76) 84%, transparent 91% 100%);
      -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 8px), #000 calc(100% - 6px), #000 calc(100% - 3px), transparent 100%);
      mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 8px), #000 calc(100% - 6px), #000 calc(100% - 3px), transparent 100%);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(255, 211, 92, 0.9)) drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(255, 92, 28, 0.48));
      animation: orbitSparkA 4.8s linear infinite;
    }

    .ring::after {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 100% 50%, #fff8d2 0 3px, #ffbc3d 4px, rgba(255, 78, 28, 0.08) 8px, transparent 12px);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255, 242, 170, 0.95)) drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(255, 104, 28, 0.62));
      animation: orbitDotA 4.8s linear infinite;
    }

    .ring:nth-child(2) {
      inset: 8%;
      border-style: dashed;
      opacity: 0.74;
      border-color: rgba(110, 222, 255, 0.72);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.12), 0 0 24px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.34), 0 0 5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.54);
      animation-name: orbitRingB;
      animation-duration: 23s;
      animation-direction: reverse;
    }

    .ring:nth-child(2)::before {
      background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 0 68%, rgba(218, 250, 255, 0.98) 77%, rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.76) 84%, transparent 93% 100%);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.84)) drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.44));
      animation: orbitSparkB 6.4s linear infinite reverse;
    }

    .ring:nth-child(2)::after {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 100% 50%, #f4feff 0 3px, #53d7ff 4px, rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.08) 8px, transparent 12px);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(220, 252, 255, 0.88)) drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.58));
      animation: orbitDotB 6.4s linear infinite reverse;
    }

    .ring:nth-child(3) {
      inset: 24%;
      border-color: rgba(255, 242, 170, 0.52);
      animation-name: orbitRingC;
      animation-duration: 31s;
    }

    .ring:nth-child(3)::before {
      animation: orbitSparkC 5.6s linear infinite;
      animation-delay: -1.8s;
    }

    .ring:nth-child(3)::after {
      animation: orbitDotC 5.6s linear infinite;
      animation-delay: -1.8s;
    }

    .orb {
      width: 48%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      z-index: 4;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 44% 45%, rgba(255, 250, 196, 0.98) 0 2%, rgba(255, 176, 40, 0.5) 8%, transparent 19%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 66% 34%, rgba(255, 246, 172, 0.72) 0 3%, rgba(255, 116, 28, 0.26) 12%, transparent 24%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 30% 68%, rgba(255, 234, 126, 0.5) 0 2%, transparent 18%),
        repeating-radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 230, 112, 0.34) 0 2px, rgba(255, 98, 34, 0.14) 2px 5px, transparent 5px 9px),
        conic-gradient(from 30deg, rgba(255, 52, 32, 0.44), rgba(255, 185, 42, 0.6), rgba(255, 245, 128, 0.46), rgba(255, 104, 28, 0.56), rgba(174, 22, 18, 0.5), rgba(255, 62, 42, 0.48));
      box-shadow: 0 0 82px rgba(255, 74, 32, 0.64), 0 0 38px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.46), 0 0 18px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.12), inset 0 0 42px rgba(255, 248, 190, 0.42), inset 0 -18px 52px rgba(152, 18, 14, 0.32);
      animation: heartBeat 4.8s ease-in-out infinite, solarSurface 18s linear infinite;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .orb::before,
    .orb::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 12%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 245, 185, 0.38);
      transform: rotate(22deg);
      animation: spin 10s linear infinite;
    }

    .orb::after {
      inset: 26%;
      border-color: rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.25);
      animation-duration: 7s;
      animation-direction: reverse;
    }

    .flare {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      width: 82%;
      height: 82%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(255, 244, 135, 0.46) 0 4%, rgba(255, 92, 28, 0.18) 12%, transparent 28%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 98% 52%, rgba(255, 218, 76, 0.34) 0 4%, rgba(255, 76, 24, 0.14) 11%, transparent 24%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%, rgba(255, 174, 42, 0.32) 0 4%, rgba(255, 56, 20, 0.13) 12%, transparent 24%);
      filter: blur(6px) saturate(1.25);
      opacity: 0.34;
      -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 58%, #000 66% 74%, transparent 82%);
      mask: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 58%, #000 66% 74%, transparent 82%);
      animation: flareSurge 9.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .flare::before,
    .flare::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: -6%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      opacity: 0.26;
      filter: blur(5px);
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 22% 18%, rgba(255, 230, 94, 0.38) 0 6%, rgba(255, 70, 20, 0.12) 17%, transparent 35%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 86%, rgba(255, 202, 72, 0.32) 0 5%, rgba(255, 60, 18, 0.1) 16%, transparent 34%);
      -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 66%, #000 73% 80%, transparent 88%);
      mask: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 66%, #000 73% 80%, transparent 88%);
    }

    .flare::before {
      animation: flameBreatheA 8.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .flare::after {
      inset: -10%;
      opacity: 0.2;
      transform: rotate(38deg);
      animation: flameBreatheB 11s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .prominence {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      width: 17%;
      height: 40%;
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
      border-radius: 54% 46% 58% 42% / 62% 64% 36% 38%;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 18%, rgba(255, 248, 158, 0.84) 0 10%, rgba(255, 178, 45, 0.62) 25%, rgba(255, 62, 19, 0.3) 50%, transparent 74%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 42% 62%, rgba(255, 118, 26, 0.34) 0 18%, transparent 58%);
      filter: blur(3.2px) saturate(1.55);
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      opacity: 0.66;
      transform-origin: 50% 88%;
    }

    .prominence::before,
    .prominence::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(255, 238, 112, 0.68) 0 10%, rgba(255, 76, 20, 0.24) 42%, transparent 72%);
      filter: blur(3px);
    }

    .prominence::before {
      width: 64%;
      height: 64%;
      left: -18%;
      top: 20%;
    }

    .prominence::after {
      width: 42%;
      height: 54%;
      right: -12%;
      top: 6%;
      opacity: 0.74;
    }

    .prominence.p1 {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-34deg) translateY(-56%) scale(1.02, 1.08);
      animation: prominenceA 9.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .prominence.p2 {
      width: 10%;
      height: 26%;
      opacity: 0.48;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(66deg) translateY(-59%) scale(0.68, 0.74);
      animation: prominenceB 12.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .prominence.p3 {
      width: 11%;
      height: 27%;
      opacity: 0.5;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(178deg) translateY(-55%) scale(0.66, 0.72);
      animation: prominenceC 10.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .prominence.p4 {
      width: 9%;
      height: 24%;
      opacity: 0.42;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(242deg) translateY(-60%) scale(0.62, 0.72);
      animation: prominenceD 14s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .corona {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      width: 94%;
      height: 94%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      background:
        conic-gradient(from 18deg,
          transparent 0 10%,
          rgba(255, 76, 26, 0.14) 12%,
          transparent 17% 31%,
          rgba(255, 186, 46, 0.16) 34%,
          transparent 39% 54%,
          rgba(255, 90, 28, 0.12) 57%,
          transparent 62% 80%,
          rgba(255, 178, 44, 0.14) 83%,
          transparent 88% 100%);
      filter: blur(9px);
      opacity: 0.26;
      -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 64%, #000 72% 80%, transparent 87%);
      mask: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 64%, #000 72% 80%, transparent 87%);
      animation: coronaBurn 15.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    /* 新フレア：炎の塊と、コアを横切る複数の楕円ループ */
    .flare,
    .prominence,
    .corona {
      display: none;
    }

    .flare-field {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 3;
      pointer-events: none;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
    }

    .flare-loop {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      width: 108%;
      height: 42%;
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      border-top-color: rgba(255, 245, 167, 0.96);
      border-bottom-color: rgba(255, 87, 25, 0.82);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255, 247, 186, 0.88), 0 0 17px rgba(255, 109, 25, 0.74), inset 0 0 8px rgba(255, 133, 26, 0.46);
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-18deg);
      animation: flareLoopOrbit 11s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .flare-loop::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: -8px;
      border: 1px dotted rgba(255, 202, 86, 0.68);
      border-left-color: transparent;
      border-right-color: rgba(255, 112, 27, 0.54);
      border-radius: inherit;
      filter: blur(1px);
    }

    .flare-loop.l2 {
      width: 76%;
      height: 116%;
      border-top-color: rgba(255, 222, 111, 0.88);
      border-bottom-color: rgba(255, 65, 20, 0.82);
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(30deg);
      animation-delay: -3.4s;
      animation-duration: 13.5s;
    }

    .flare-loop.l3 {
      width: 126%;
      height: 28%;
      border-top-color: rgba(255, 160, 45, 0.72);
      border-bottom-color: rgba(255, 53, 20, 0.66);
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(18deg);
      opacity: 0.72;
      animation-delay: -6.2s;
      animation-duration: 16s;
    }

    .flare-tongue {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      width: 16%;
      height: 34%;
      border-radius: 58% 42% 62% 38% / 70% 66% 34% 30%;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 12%, rgba(255, 255, 211, 0.98) 0 8%, rgba(255, 219, 80, 0.92) 18%, rgba(255, 92, 22, 0.72) 48%, rgba(198, 22, 12, 0.22) 72%, transparent 82%);
      filter: blur(3px) saturate(1.8);
      opacity: 0.82;
      transform-origin: 50% 92%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -88%) rotate(-38deg) scale(1.08, 1.16);
      animation: flareTongueA 6.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .flare-tongue::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 76%;
      height: 58%;
      left: 20%;
      top: 28%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(255, 251, 173, 0.86), rgba(255, 81, 18, 0.42) 48%, transparent 74%);
      filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .flare-tongue.t2 {
      width: 13%;
      height: 28%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -88%) rotate(46deg) scale(0.92);
      animation-name: flareTongueB;
      animation-delay: -2.1s;
    }

    .flare-tongue.t3 {
      width: 12%;
      height: 25%;
      transform: translate(-50%, 4%) rotate(168deg) scale(0.88);
      animation-name: flareTongueC;
      animation-delay: -4.7s;
      opacity: 0.64;
    }

    .scan {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      width: 34%;
      height: 34%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      z-index: 7;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 222, 130, 0.24);
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      animation: scanOrbitVertical 19s linear infinite;
      opacity: 0.9;
      box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.12);
    }

    .task-panel {
      min-height: 420px;
      max-height: calc(100vh - 174px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.34);
      border-radius: 18px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 20, 37, 0.86), rgba(3, 9, 19, 0.92)),
        radial-gradient(circle at 24% 16%, rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.12), transparent 34%);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 58px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34), inset 0 0 44px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.07);
      padding: 15px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
      gap: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .app.task-hidden .task-panel {
      display: none;
    }

    .task-title {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.18);
      padding-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .task-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .task-toggle {
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.34);
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.1);
      color: #ffe6ad;
      cursor: pointer;
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      padding: 6px 9px;
    }

    .task-restore {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      right: 14px;
      top: 50%;
      z-index: 5;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.42);
      color: #dff6ff;
      background: rgba(8, 20, 37, 0.92);
      border-radius: 14px 0 0 14px;
      padding: 12px 9px;
      cursor: pointer;
      writing-mode: vertical-rl;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.18);
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .app.task-hidden .task-restore {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .task-restore:hover {
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      border-color: rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.42);
      background: rgba(8, 20, 37, 0.92);
    }

    .task-title strong {
      color: #ffe0a1;
      font-size: 1rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    }

    .pulse-dot {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.84);
      animation: taskPulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .task-stack {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      align-content: start;
    }

    .task-card {
      border: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.16);
      border-radius: 13px;
      background: rgba(4, 15, 29, 0.68);
      padding: 10px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 24px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .task-label {
      color: var(--cyan);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
    }

    .task-value {
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.45;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
    }

    .route-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .route-chip {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.14);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 7px 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: rgba(10, 24, 42, 0.55);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
    }

    .route-chip.active {
      color: #ffe7b2;
      border-color: rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.54);
      background: rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.11);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.1);
    }

    .route-chip.active::after {
      content: "ON";
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    }

    .task-bars {
      display: flex;
      align-items: end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 3px;
      height: 24px;
      padding: 4px 0 0;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .task-bars span {
      width: 2px;
      min-width: 2px;
      flex: 1 1 0;
      max-width: 4px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 232, 150, 0.98), rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.72));
      box-shadow: 0 0 7px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.36);
      opacity: 0.58;
      height: 18%;
      animation: none;
      animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * -0.065s);
      transition: height 180ms ease, opacity 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, filter 180ms ease;
    }

    .task-panel[data-state="listening"] .task-bars span,
    .task-panel[data-state="thinking"] .task-bars span,
    .task-panel[data-state="speaking"] .task-bars span {
      opacity: 0.78;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.22);
      animation: levelMeter 1.08s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .task-panel[data-state="speaking"] .task-bars span {
      animation-duration: 0.62s;
    }

    .task-panel[data-state="thinking"] .task-bars span:nth-child(2n),
    .task-panel[data-state="listening"] .task-bars span:nth-child(3n),
    .task-panel[data-state="speaking"] .task-bars span:nth-child(odd) {
      animation-delay: 120ms;
    }

    .safety-lines {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      color: #d9f2ff;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
    }

    .safety-lines span::before {
      content: "";
      display: inline-block;
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      margin-right: 8px;
      background: var(--cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.76);
    }

    .console {
      height: calc(100vh - 174px);
      min-height: 420px;
      max-height: calc(100vh - 174px);
      min-width: 0;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 18, 34, 0.78), rgba(4, 9, 20, 0.88));
      box-shadow: 0 22px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34), inset 0 0 40px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.06);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .console-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.14);
      color: var(--cyan);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .log {
      min-height: 0;
      overflow-y: auto;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      overscroll-behavior: contain;
      padding: 18px 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      scrollbar-color: rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.72) rgba(3, 12, 24, 0.72);
      scrollbar-width: auto;
    }

    .log::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; }
    .log::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: rgba(3, 12, 24, 0.72); border-radius: 999px; }
    .log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.72); border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid rgba(3, 12, 24, 0.72); }
    .log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.82); }

    .msg {
      max-width: 88%;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      line-height: 1.55;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      white-space: normal;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      word-break: break-word;
    }

    .msg.user {
      align-self: flex-end;
      display: block;
      color: var(--text);
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(8, 92, 128, 0.72), rgba(2, 54, 81, 0.78));
      border-color: rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.32);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.12);
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .msg.nexus {
      align-self: flex-start;
      background: rgba(22, 31, 49, 0.86);
      border-color: rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.16);
    }

    .msg small {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: var(--cyan);
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-size: 0.68rem;
    }

    details {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.14);
      padding: 10px 16px 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.86rem;
    }

    summary {
      cursor: pointer;
      color: #c7eaff;
    }

    .input-area {
      display: grid;
      gap: 6px;
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }

    .quick {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding: 0 4px 4px 86px;
    }

    .quick button,
    .task-restore,
    .tool-btn {
      border: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.22);
      color: #dff6ff;
      background: rgba(17, 31, 51, 0.86);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 9px 13px;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      font: inherit;
      transition: transform 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease;
    }

    button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      border-color: rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.48);
    }

    .composer {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 76px 1fr 104px;
      gap: 9px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 8px 4px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.18);
      position: relative;
    }

    .composer input {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      opacity: 0.01;
      border: 0;
      outline: 0;
      background: transparent;
      color: transparent;
      caret-color: transparent;
      z-index: -1;
    }

    .typing-status {
      min-width: 0;
      height: 44px;
      display: block;
      border-radius: 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.26);
      background: rgba(13, 25, 43, 0.92);
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 0 16px;
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 44px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 22px rgba(83, 215, 255, 0.05);
      outline: none;
      cursor: text;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .typing-status:empty::before {
      content: "STANDBY — Use Mic to speak, or start typing.";
      color: #d8ecff;
    }

    .typing-status.active {
      border-color: rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.58);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.1);
    }

    footer {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.74rem;
      padding-top: 0;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .safe {
      color: #cfe3f7;
    }

    #recordingBtn.voice-on {
      border-color: rgba(255, 165, 45, 0.95);
      background: rgba(255, 132, 24, 0.30);
      color: #fff1cf;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 153, 36, 0.90), 0 0 28px rgba(255, 116, 20, 0.68), inset 0 0 18px rgba(255, 190, 74, 0.28);
    }

    #micBtn.voice-on {
      border-color: rgba(255, 165, 45, 0.95);
      background: rgba(255, 132, 24, 0.30);
      color: #fff1cf;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 153, 36, 0.90), 0 0 28px rgba(255, 116, 20, 0.68), inset 0 0 18px rgba(255, 190, 74, 0.28);
    }

    @keyframes spin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    @keyframes orbitRingA {
      0% { transform: rotateX(64deg) rotateY(0deg) rotateZ(0deg); }
      50% { transform: rotateX(64deg) rotateY(180deg) rotateZ(4deg); }
      100% { transform: rotateX(64deg) rotateY(360deg) rotateZ(0deg); }
    }

    @keyframes orbitRingB {
      0% { transform: rotateX(18deg) rotateY(360deg) rotateZ(78deg); }
      50% { transform: rotateX(26deg) rotateY(180deg) rotateZ(98deg); }
      100% { transform: rotateX(18deg) rotateY(0deg) rotateZ(78deg); }
    }

    @keyframes orbitRingC {
      0% { transform: rotateX(76deg) rotateY(0deg) rotateZ(-32deg); }
      50% { transform: rotateX(68deg) rotateY(-180deg) rotateZ(-18deg); }
      100% { transform: rotateX(76deg) rotateY(-360deg) rotateZ(-32deg); }
    }

    @keyframes orbitSparkA {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    @keyframes orbitDotA {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    @keyframes orbitSparkB {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    @keyframes orbitDotB {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    @keyframes orbitSparkC {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    @keyframes orbitDotC {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    @keyframes solarDrift {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) scale(1); }
      33% { transform: rotateX(1.8deg) rotateY(-2.2deg) scale(1.006); }
      66% { transform: rotateX(-1.2deg) rotateY(1.6deg) scale(0.998); }
    }

    @keyframes heartBeat {
      0%, 22%, 100% { transform: scale(0.985); opacity: 0.92; }
      9% { transform: scale(1.01); opacity: 0.97; }
      28% { transform: scale(1.04); opacity: 1; }
      44% { transform: scale(0.99); opacity: 0.94; }
    }

    @keyframes solarSurface {
      to { background-position: 0 0, 32px 48px, 360deg; }
    }

    @keyframes flareSurge {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.28; filter: blur(7px) saturate(1.18); }
      45% { opacity: 0.42; filter: blur(5px) saturate(1.34); }
      68% { opacity: 0.32; filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.22); }
    }

    @keyframes flameBreatheA {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.94); }
      40% { opacity: 0.34; transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(1.04); }
      72% { opacity: 0.24; transform: rotate(6deg) scale(1.0); }
    }

    @keyframes flameBreatheB {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.14; transform: rotate(38deg) scale(0.96); }
      52% { opacity: 0.28; transform: rotate(28deg) scale(1.08); }
    }

    @keyframes prominenceA {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.34; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-34deg) translateY(-53%) scale(0.62, 0.66); }
      36% { opacity: 0.72; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-38deg) translateY(-61%) scale(0.94, 1.08); }
      62% { opacity: 0.48; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-29deg) translateY(-57%) scale(0.78, 0.86); }
    }

    @keyframes prominenceB {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.18; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(66deg) translateY(-56%) scale(0.46, 0.52); }
      48% { opacity: 0.5; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(72deg) translateY(-62%) scale(0.72, 0.78); }
      76% { opacity: 0.3; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(58deg) translateY(-58%) scale(0.58, 0.66); }
    }

    @keyframes prominenceC {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.18; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(178deg) translateY(-52%) scale(0.42, 0.48); }
      42% { opacity: 0.48; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(170deg) translateY(-58%) scale(0.66, 0.76); }
      70% { opacity: 0.3; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(184deg) translateY(-55%) scale(0.54, 0.62); }
    }

    @keyframes prominenceD {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.14; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(242deg) translateY(-56%) scale(0.38, 0.44); }
      52% { opacity: 0.42; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(235deg) translateY(-62%) scale(0.6, 0.72); }
    }

    @keyframes coronaBurn {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.58; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg) scale(0.94); }
      42% { opacity: 0.92; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(16deg) scale(1.08); }
      68% { opacity: 0.74; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-8deg) scale(1.0); }
    }

    @keyframes flareLoopOrbit {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-18deg) scale(0.96, 0.94); opacity: 0.54; }
      38% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(3deg) scale(1.04, 1.08); opacity: 0.96; }
      70% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-31deg) scale(0.98, 1.02); opacity: 0.72; }
    }

    @keyframes flareTongueA {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.48; filter: blur(4px) saturate(1.45); }
      42% { opacity: 0.96; filter: blur(2px) saturate(2.1); transform: translate(-50%, -88%) rotate(-27deg) scale(1.18, 1.34); }
      72% { opacity: 0.7; transform: translate(-50%, -88%) rotate(-48deg) scale(0.96, 1.05); }
    }

    @keyframes flareTongueB {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.32; }
      54% { opacity: 0.86; transform: translate(-50%, -88%) rotate(62deg) scale(1.12); }
    }

    @keyframes flareTongueC {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.24; }
      48% { opacity: 0.72; transform: translate(-50%, 4%) rotate(150deg) scale(1.08); }
    }

    @keyframes auraBreathe {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(0.98); opacity: 0.48; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.06); opacity: 0.92; }
    }

    @keyframes replyPulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.95; }
      45% { transform: scale(1.1); opacity: 1; }
    }

    @keyframes nexusReply {
      0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 44px rgba(255, 191, 61, 0.48)); }
      50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 76px rgba(255, 220, 120, 0.78)); }
    }

    @keyframes scanOrbitVertical {
      0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotateY(86deg) rotateX(4deg) rotateZ(0deg); }
      50% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotateY(86deg) rotateX(-8deg) rotateZ(180deg); }
      100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotateY(86deg) rotateX(4deg) rotateZ(360deg); }
    }

    @keyframes satelliteOrbitA {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg) translateX(51%) rotate(0deg) scale(0.78); opacity: 0.42; }
      22% { transform: rotate(86deg) translateX(42%) rotate(-60deg) scale(1); opacity: 0.92; }
      54% { transform: rotate(205deg) translateX(56%) rotate(-140deg) scale(0.86); opacity: 0.66; }
      78% { transform: rotate(302deg) translateX(46%) rotate(-240deg) scale(1.08); opacity: 0.98; }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg) translateX(51%) rotate(-360deg) scale(0.78); opacity: 0.42; }
    }

    @keyframes satelliteOrbitB {
      0% { transform: rotate(42deg) translateX(62%) rotate(0deg) scale(0.7); opacity: 0.34; }
      30% { transform: rotate(155deg) translateX(48%) rotate(-120deg) scale(1.12); opacity: 0.82; }
      64% { transform: rotate(270deg) translateX(58%) rotate(-220deg) scale(0.8); opacity: 0.5; }
      100% { transform: rotate(402deg) translateX(62%) rotate(-360deg) scale(0.7); opacity: 0.34; }
    }

    @keyframes satelliteOrbitC {
      0% { transform: rotate(118deg) translateX(45%) rotate(0deg) scale(0.82); opacity: 0.38; }
      36% { transform: rotate(240deg) translateX(64%) rotate(-130deg) scale(1.06); opacity: 0.88; }
      72% { transform: rotate(330deg) translateX(50%) rotate(-260deg) scale(0.76); opacity: 0.46; }
      100% { transform: rotate(478deg) translateX(45%) rotate(-360deg) scale(0.82); opacity: 0.38; }
    }

    @keyframes taskPulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(0.86); opacity: 0.58; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 1; }
    }

    @keyframes barFlow {
      0%, 100% { height: 18%; }
      50% { height: var(--bar-height, 70%); }
    }

    @keyframes levelMeter {
      0%, 100% {
        height: 18%;
        opacity: 0.42;
        filter: saturate(0.9);
      }
      38% {
        height: var(--bar-height, 68%);
        opacity: 0.96;
        filter: saturate(1.35);
      }
      64% {
        height: calc(var(--bar-height, 68%) * 0.56);
        opacity: 0.66;
      }
    }

    @keyframes coreAfterimage {
      0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: rotate(22deg) scale(0.92);
        filter: blur(0px);
      }
      18% {
        opacity: 0.78;
        transform: rotate(28deg) scale(1.06);
        filter: blur(1px);
      }
      58% {
        opacity: 0.34;
        transform: rotate(42deg) scale(1.16);
        filter: blur(2.5px);
      }
      100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: rotate(56deg) scale(1.28);
        filter: blur(4px);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 980px) {
      body { overflow: auto; }
      .app { min-height: 100vh; }
      .main {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .holo-wrap {
        min-height: 340px;
      }
      .holo {
        width: min(76vw, 420px);
      }
      .console {
        min-height: 360px;
        max-height: none;
      }
      .task-panel {
        min-height: 320px;
        max-height: none;
      }
      .app.task-hidden .main {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .quick {
        padding-left: 4px;
      }
      .composer {
        grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
      }
      #modeBadge {
        min-width: 104px;
      }
    }


/* v0.5.40 — plasma flare only. Existing orb/rings/UI remain unchanged. */
.solar-plasma{
  position:absolute;
  left:50%; top:50%;
  width:72%; height:72%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  z-index:3;
  pointer-events:none;
  overflow:visible;
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
}
.solar-plasma svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.nexus-corona{
  fill:none;
  stroke:url(#nexusFlareHot);
  filter:url(#nexusPlasmaDistort);
  transform-origin:250px 250px;
}
.nexus-corona.c1{
  stroke-width:9;
  stroke-dasharray:3 13 19 9 5 17;
  opacity:.35;
  animation:nexusCoronaSlow 26s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.nexus-corona.c2{
  stroke-width:4;
  stroke-dasharray:17 22 5 28;
  opacity:.22;
  animation:nexusCoronaSlow 37s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
}
.nexus-prominence{
  fill:none;
  stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round;
  transform-origin:250px 250px;
  filter:url(#nexusPlasmaDistort);
}
.plasma-glow{
  stroke:#ff5a1c;
  stroke-width:9;
  opacity:.25;
  filter:url(#nexusFlareGlow);
}
.plasma-hot{
  stroke:url(#nexusFlareHot);
  stroke-width:3.6;
  opacity:.82;
  filter:url(#nexusFlareGlow);
}
.flare-fork{stroke-width:2.4;opacity:.62}
.np1{animation:nexusFlareLifeA 8.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.np2{animation:nexusFlareLifeB 10.5s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-2.8s}
.np3{animation:nexusFlareLifeC 12s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-6.2s}
.np4{animation:nexusFlareLifeB 7.4s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-1.2s;transform-origin:250px 250px}
.np5{animation:nexusFlareLifeC 13.5s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-8.1s;transform-origin:250px 250px}
.np6{animation:nexusFlareLifeA 6.8s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-3.9s;transform-origin:250px 250px}
.np7{animation:nexusFlareLifeB 14.8s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-10.4s;transform-origin:250px 250px}
.np8{animation:nexusFlareLifeC 9.2s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-5.1s;transform-origin:250px 250px}
.np4 .plasma-hot,.np4 .plasma-glow{stroke-width:3.2}
.np5 .plasma-hot{stroke-width:5.2}.np5 .plasma-glow{stroke-width:16}
.np6 .plasma-hot{stroke-width:2.7}.np6 .plasma-glow{stroke-width:9}
.np7 .plasma-hot{stroke-width:4}.np7 .plasma-glow{stroke-width:13}
.np8 .plasma-hot{stroke-width:2.3}.np8 .plasma-glow{stroke-width:7}



.np9{animation:nexusFlareLifeA 6.2s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-1.1s}
.np10{animation:nexusFlareLifeB 7.1s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-4.7s}
.np11{animation:nexusFlareLifeC 5.8s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-2.9s}
.np12{animation:nexusFlareLifeA 8.3s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-6.1s}
.np13{animation:nexusFlareLifeB 6.6s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-3.4s}
.np14{animation:nexusFlareLifeC 7.7s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:-5.5s}
.np9 .plasma-glow,.np11 .plasma-glow,.np13 .plasma-glow{stroke-width:6}
.np10 .plasma-glow,.np12 .plasma-glow,.np14 .plasma-glow{stroke-width:8}
.np9 .plasma-hot,.np11 .plasma-hot,.np13 .plasma-hot{stroke-width:2.1}
.np10 .plasma-hot,.np12 .plasma-hot,.np14 .plasma-hot{stroke-width:2.8}

@keyframes nexusCoronaSlow{
  0%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg) scale(.985);opacity:.20}
  48%{transform:rotate(7deg) scale(1.025);opacity:.40}
  76%{transform:rotate(-3deg) scale(1.005);opacity:.29}
}
@keyframes nexusFlareLifeA{
  0%,12%,100%{opacity:.06;transform:rotate(-3deg) scale(.76,.58)}
  30%{opacity:.58;transform:rotate(-6deg) scale(.94,.88)}
  48%{opacity:.96;transform:rotate(2deg) scale(1.10,1.18)}
  68%{opacity:.88;transform:rotate(7deg) scale(1.02,1.08)}
  86%{opacity:.16;transform:rotate(10deg) scale(.88,.82)}
}
@keyframes nexusFlareLifeB{
  0%,18%,100%{opacity:.04;transform:rotate(4deg) scale(.72,.55)}
  38%{opacity:.72;transform:rotate(0deg) scale(.96,.91)}
  57%{opacity:.92;transform:rotate(-6deg) scale(1.12,1.24)}
  76%{opacity:.43;transform:rotate(-10deg) scale(1.04,1.06)}
  91%{opacity:.10;transform:rotate(-13deg) scale(.86,.78)}
}
@keyframes nexusFlareLifeC{
  0%,25%,100%{opacity:.03;transform:rotate(-2deg) scale(.70,.52)}
  45%{opacity:.56;transform:rotate(3deg) scale(.93,.86)}
  62%{opacity:.84;transform:rotate(8deg) scale(1.08,1.17)}
  80%{opacity:.62;transform:rotate(13deg) scale(1.00,.98)}
  94%{opacity:.08;transform:rotate(16deg) scale(.84,.72)}
}


/* v0.5.46 — surface pulse: flare rises only slightly from the surface, then collapses back */
.nexus-prominence{
  transform-box:view-box;
  transform-origin:250px 250px;
}
.np1,.np2,.np3,.np4,.np5,.np6,.np7,.np8,
.np9,.np10,.np11,.np12,.np13,.np14{
  animation-name:nexusSurfacePulse !important;
  animation-timing-function:ease-in-out !important;
}
.np1{animation-duration:5.7s!important}.np2{animation-duration:6.4s!important}
.np3{animation-duration:7.1s!important}.np4{animation-duration:5.1s!important}
.np5{animation-duration:6.8s!important}.np6{animation-duration:4.9s!important}
.np7{animation-duration:7.5s!important}.np8{animation-duration:5.9s!important}
.np9{animation-duration:4.6s!important}.np10{animation-duration:5.4s!important}
.np11{animation-duration:4.8s!important}.np12{animation-duration:6.1s!important}
.np13{animation-duration:5.0s!important}.np14{animation-duration:5.6s!important}

/* Base scale .72 pulls the old long geometry close to the sphere.
   Peak is only .82: a short crest, not a long tongue. */
@keyframes nexusSurfacePulse{
  0%,16%,100%{opacity:.03;transform:scale(.70)}
  30%{opacity:.34;transform:scale(.74)}
  46%{opacity:.86;transform:scale(.82)}
  59%{opacity:.62;transform:scale(.79)}
  75%{opacity:.24;transform:scale(.74)}
  88%{opacity:.07;transform:scale(.71)}
}


/* v0.5.47 — countless fine micro-flares hugging the core perimeter */
#microCorona{will-change:transform,opacity;
  position:absolute;
  left:50%; top:50%;
  width:44%; height:44%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  z-index:4;
  pointer-events:none;
  overflow:visible;
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(255,108,22,.55));
}


/* v0.5.48 — visible flares layered over the existing micro-corona */
#visibleCorona{will-change:transform,opacity;
  position:absolute;
  left:50%; top:50%;
  width:48%; height:48%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  z-index:5;
  pointer-events:none;
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,105,20,.7));
}


/* v0.5.49 — original large prominence layer made more restrained */
.nexus-prominence{
  opacity:.62;
}
.nexus-prominence .plasma-glow{
  stroke-width:5.5 !important;
  opacity:.15 !important;
}
.nexus-prominence .plasma-hot{
  stroke-width:2.4 !important;
  opacity:.58 !important;
}
.nexus-prominence.flare-fork,
.nexus-prominence .flare-fork{
  opacity:.38 !important;
}


/* v0.5.50 — fine wavering flare filaments layered onto the existing flare system */
#fineWavyCorona{will-change:transform,opacity;
  position:absolute;
  left:50%; top:50%;
  width:50%; height:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  z-index:6;
  pointer-events:none;
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(255,120,28,.55));
}


#outerWavyCorona{will-change:transform,opacity;
  position:absolute;
  left:50%; top:50%;
  width:61%; height:61%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  z-index:5;
  pointer-events:none;
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(255,105,20,.48));
}


/* v0.5.53 — de-synchronise original prominence appearances */
.np1{animation-duration:6.13s!important;animation-delay:-1.37s!important}
.np2{animation-duration:9.47s!important;animation-delay:-6.22s!important}
.np3{animation-duration:7.83s!important;animation-delay:-2.91s!important}
.np4{animation-duration:5.39s!important;animation-delay:-4.18s!important}
.np5{animation-duration:10.71s!important;animation-delay:-7.46s!important}
.np6{animation-duration:4.77s!important;animation-delay:-1.93s!important}
.np7{animation-duration:11.29s!important;animation-delay:-8.17s!important}
.np8{animation-duration:6.91s!important;animation-delay:-3.54s!important}
.np9{animation-duration:5.23s!important;animation-delay:-2.48s!important}
.np10{animation-duration:8.19s!important;animation-delay:-5.72s!important}
.np11{animation-duration:4.91s!important;animation-delay:-3.13s!important}
.np12{animation-duration:9.11s!important;animation-delay:-6.63s!important}
.np13{animation-duration:5.67s!important;animation-delay:-4.09s!important}
.np14{animation-duration:7.37s!important;animation-delay:-1.81s!important}


/* v0.5.54 — restrained liquid motion inside the core only */
#liquidCore{
  position:absolute;
  inset:5%;
  width:90%;
  height:90%;
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.34;

  filter:blur(.35px);

/* v0.5.57 — liquid is visible on the surface, like a moving sea */
#oceanSurface{
  position:absolute;
  inset:3%;
  width:94%;
  height:94%;
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.82;
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
  filter:blur(.15px);
}



/* v0.5.60 — seamless loop: exact same visual state at 0% and 100% */
@keyframes nexusSurfacePulse{
  0%,100%{opacity:.03;transform:scale(.70)}
  14%{opacity:.05;transform:scale(.705)}
  30%{opacity:.34;transform:scale(.74)}
  48%{opacity:.86;transform:scale(.82)}
  62%{opacity:.58;transform:scale(.785)}
  78%{opacity:.20;transform:scale(.735)}
  92%{opacity:.05;transform:scale(.705)}
}


/* v0.5.62 — original 3 rings restored; add 3 more rings in the same visual family */
.ring-extra{opacity:.58;pointer-events:none}
.ring-extra-1{
  width:69%;height:69%;

  animation:ringSpin 19s linear infinite reverse !important;
}

  animation:ringSpin 23s linear infinite reverse !important;
}

.ring-extra-4{
  display:none !important;
  animation:none !important;
}


/* v0.5.75 — duplicate 3-ring group and overlap the right text panel */

}
.overlap-ring-2{

}

}


/* v0.5.84 — ONE core at the exact center of the added upper-left horizontal ring */
.left-horizontal-ring-core{

    repeating-radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,213,90,.18) 0 1.3px,rgba(255,74,13,.06) 2px 4px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 42% 39%,
      rgba(255,255,224,.98) 0 3%,

      rgba(255,75,12,.94) 43%,

  box-shadow:

    0 0 34px rgba(255,65,10,.58);
  animation:leftRingCorePulse 7.1s ease-in-out infinite;
}

  50%{filter:brightness(1.14);opacity:1}
}

<style>
/* v0.5.87 lightweight core input meter */
#coreInputMeterLite{
  --e:0;
  position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%;
  width:47%; aspect-ratio:1; transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,145,38,.12);
  border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none; z-index:20;
  opacity:.11;
  box-shadow:0 0 calc(2px + var(--e)*4px) rgba(255,112,24,.22);
  transition:opacity .28s ease, transform .20s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
}
#coreInputMeterLite::before,
#coreInputMeterLite::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:15%; border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,185,72,.25);
  transform:scale(calc(.92 + var(--e)*.08));
  transition:transform .12s ease-out, opacity .22s ease;
}
#coreInputMeterLite::after{
  inset:34%;
  border-color:rgba(255,225,155,.34);
  transform:scale(calc(.86 + var(--e)*.14));
}
.holo.nexus-input-active #coreInputMeterLite{
  opacity:calc(.26 + var(--e)*.38);
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(calc(1 + var(--e)*.034));
}

</style>

    0 0 22px rgba(255,181,50,.30),
    0 0 12px rgba(48,175,215,.06),
    inset 0 0 28px rgba(255,226,145,.28),
    inset 0 -18px 38px rgba(8,48,88,.13) !important;
}

/* 既存の年輪・リングを少しだけ明瞭化 */
.orb::before,
.orb::after {
  opacity: .88 !important;
  filter: contrast(1.24) saturate(1.06) !important;
}
</style>


<style id="nexus-tree-rings-independent-gradient">
/* 年輪だけ独立グラデーション化。コア本体とは色相をずらして埋もれないようにする */
.orb::before {
  opacity: .92 !important;
  filter:
    hue-rotate(205deg)
    saturate(1.28)
    brightness(1.12)
    contrast(1.30)
    drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(115,235,255,.22)) !important;
}

.orb::after {
  opacity: .90 !important;
  filter:
    hue-rotate(238deg)
    saturate(1.22)
    brightness(1.08)
    contrast(1.28)
    drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(170,145,255,.18)) !important;
}

/* 年輪の見え方に青白→青紫→薄い金の変化を加える */
.orb {
  --ring-cool: rgba(115,235,255,.72);
  --ring-mid: rgba(112,145,255,.62);
  --ring-warm: rgba(255,214,132,.52);
}
</style>


<style id="nexus-extra-small-cores">
/* 既存の小コアはそのまま。追加2個だけ色と周回位相を変更 */
.satellite-extra { pointer-events:none !important; }
.satellite-cyan {
  filter: hue-rotate(155deg) saturate(1.45) brightness(1.15) !important;
  animation-delay: -2.7s !important;
}
.satellite-violet {
  filter: hue-rotate(245deg) saturate(1.35) brightness(1.12) !important;
  animation-delay: -5.4s !important;
}
</style>


<style id="nexus-remove-marked-three-flare-tongues">

.flare-tongue.t2,
.flare-tongue.t3 {
  display: none !important;
}
</style>


<style id="nexus-laser-safe-layer">
.nexus-laser-safe {
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:50%;
  width:72%;
  height:72%;
  z-index:18;
  pointer-events:none;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
  transform-origin:50% 50%;
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
  animation:nexusLaserSafe3D 60s linear infinite;
}
.nexus-laser-safe .lh,
.nexus-laser-safe .lv {
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
}
.nexus-laser-safe .lh {
  width:100%;
  height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,112,38,.16) 18%,rgba(255,150,52,.72) 42%,rgba(255,252,220,.98) 50%,rgba(255,150,52,.72) 58%,rgba(255,112,38,.16) 82%,transparent);
  box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(255,250,220,.9),0 0 14px rgba(255,92,36,.65);
}
.nexus-laser-safe .lv {
  width:2px;
  height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(65,210,255,.12) 18%,rgba(75,220,255,.62) 42%,rgba(255,255,235,.98) 50%,rgba(255,150,55,.62) 58%,rgba(255,90,38,.12) 82%,transparent);
  box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(245,255,255,.9),0 0 14px rgba(55,195,255,.55);
}
@keyframes nexusLaserSafe3D {
  0%   { transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) rotateZ(0deg); }
  25%  { transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(90deg) rotateY(45deg) rotateZ(30deg); }
  50%  { transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(180deg) rotateY(180deg) rotateZ(90deg); }
  75%  { transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(270deg) rotateY(315deg) rotateZ(150deg); }
  100% { transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(360deg) rotateY(360deg) rotateZ(360deg); }
}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe {
  position:absolute;
  inset:12%;
  z-index:17;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i {
  position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,244,205,.70);
  box-shadow:0 0 3px rgba(255,190,100,.26);
  animation:nexusStarSafe 4.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i:nth-child(2n){background:rgba(170,235,255,.72);box-shadow:0 0 3px rgba(70,200,255,.24)}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i:nth-child(3n){background:rgba(205,175,255,.68);box-shadow:0 0 3px rgba(155,110,255,.20)}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i:nth-child(5n){background:rgba(255,175,195,.66);box-shadow:0 0 3px rgba(255,100,150,.18)}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i:nth-child(1){left:18%;top:31%;animation-delay:-.3s}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i:nth-child(2){left:78%;top:27%;animation-delay:-1.1s}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i:nth-child(3){left:84%;top:62%;animation-delay:-2s}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i:nth-child(4){left:24%;top:76%;animation-delay:-1.5s}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i:nth-child(5){left:61%;top:14%;animation-delay:-2.4s}
.nexus-laser-stars-safe i:nth-child(6){left:12%;top:56%;animation-delay:-.8s}
@keyframes nexusStarSafe{0%,100%{opacity:.08;transform:scale(.72)}50%{opacity:.42;transform:scale(1.08)}}
</style>


<style id="nexus-subtle-starfield">

<style id="nexus-chat-shooting-stars">
.console{position:relative;}
.nexus-shooting-star-layer{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:1;
}
.console > *:not(.nexus-shooting-star-layer){
  position:relative;
  z-index:2;
}
.nexus-shooting-star{
  position:absolute;
  left:-22%;
  top:var(--y);
  width:var(--len);
  height:1px;
  opacity:0;
  transform:rotate(var(--angle)) scale(var(--scale));
  transform-origin:right center;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,rgba(120,205,255,.06) 35%,rgba(210,240,255,.40) 82%,rgba(255,255,255,.88) 100%);
  filter:blur(var(--blur));
  box-shadow:0 0 var(--glow) rgba(125,215,255,.20);
  animation:nexusShootingStar var(--duration) linear infinite;
  animation-delay:var(--delay);
}
.nexus-shooting-star::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;right:-1px;top:50%;
  width:3px;height:3px;margin-top:-1.5px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(245,252,255,.90);
  box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(150,225,255,.48);
}
@keyframes nexusShootingStar{
  0%,80%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(var(--angle)) scale(var(--scale));}
  82%,88%{opacity:var(--opacity);}
  92%,100%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(125vw,30px,0) rotate(var(--angle)) scale(var(--scale));}
}
</style>

<style id="nexus-soft-white-edge-glow">

  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;

<style id="nexus-chat-background-stars">
.console{
  isolation:isolate !important;
}
.nexus-chat-starfield{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  z-index:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.nexus-chat-starfield i{
  position:absolute;
  width:var(--s);
  height:var(--s);
  border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  opacity:var(--o);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 3px rgba(220,245,255,.42),
    0 0 7px rgba(130,205,255,.15);
  animation:nexusChatStarTwinkle var(--d) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite;
}
@keyframes nexusChatStarTwinkle{
  0%,100%{opacity:calc(var(--o) * .45); transform:scale(.82);}
  50%{opacity:var(--o); transform:scale(1.12);}
}
.console > :not(.nexus-chat-starfield){
  position:relative;
  z-index:2;
}
</style>


<style id="nexus-chat-stars-visible-layout-restored">
/* 前版のレイアウト干渉を打ち消す */
.console > :not(.nexus-chat-starfield){
  position:static !important;
  z-index:auto !important;
}

/* 星レイヤーだけを欄内背景として保持 */
.console{
  position:relative !important;
  isolation:isolate !important;
}
.nexus-chat-starfield{
  position:absolute !important;
  inset:0 !important;
  z-index:0 !important;
  pointer-events:none !important;
}

/* 写真でも確認できる程度まで星を明るく・少し大きく */
.nexus-chat-starfield i{
  width:calc(var(--s) * 1.55) !important;
  height:calc(var(--s) * 1.55) !important;
  opacity:calc(var(--o) * 2.2) !important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,1) !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.82),
    0 0 8px rgba(175,225,255,.48),
    0 0 14px rgba(105,185,255,.18) !important;
}
@keyframes nexusChatStarTwinkle{
  0%,100%{opacity:calc(var(--o) * 1.15); transform:scale(.88);}
  50%{opacity:calc(var(--o) * 2.2); transform:scale(1.16);}
}
</style>


<style id="nexus-stars-balanced-fullscreen">

  display:none !important;

    brightness(1.22)

}
</style>


<style id="nexus-chat-stars-balanced">
/* チャット領域付近だけ控えめに補助星を追加 */
.nexus-chat-balance-stars{
  position:fixed;
  left:20%;
  top:30%;
  width:42%;
  height:48%;
  z-index:7;
  pointer-events:none;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.nexus-chat-balance-stars i{
  position:absolute;
  width:var(--s);
  height:var(--s);
  border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  opacity:var(--o);
  box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(180,225,255,.35);
  animation:nexusChatBalanceTwinkle var(--d) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite;
}
@keyframes nexusChatBalanceTwinkle{
  0%,100%{opacity:calc(var(--o) * .55);}
  50%{opacity:var(--o);}
}

/* チャット奥にごく薄い遠景の微光を追加。文字・既存星・流れ星は変更しない */
.nexus-chat-balance-stars::before,
.nexus-chat-balance-stars::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.18;
  filter:blur(18px);
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
}
.nexus-chat-balance-stars::before{
  width:150px;
  height:72px;
  left:12%;
  top:38%;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(70,205,255,.16) 0%, rgba(70,155,255,.055) 44%, transparent 74%);
  animation:nexusChatDepthDriftA 48s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
.nexus-chat-balance-stars::after{
  width:180px;
  height:82px;
  right:7%;
  top:17%;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(175,105,255,.12) 0%, rgba(95,145,255,.045) 46%, transparent 76%);
  animation:nexusChatDepthDriftB 61s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes nexusChatDepthDriftA{
  from{transform:translate3d(-8px,7px,0) scale(.94);opacity:.10;}
  to{transform:translate3d(24px,-13px,0) scale(1.08);opacity:.22;}
}
@keyframes nexusChatDepthDriftB{
  from{transform:translate3d(10px,-5px,0) scale(1.04);opacity:.08;}
  to{transform:translate3d(-25px,16px,0) scale(.93);opacity:.19;}
}


/* 遠景のハレー彗星：左上から右下へ、静止した神秘的な光 */
.nexus-chat-milkyway{
  position:fixed;
  left:4%;
  top:5%;
  width:94%;
  height:82%;
  z-index:7;
  pointer-events:none;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.nexus-chat-milkyway::before{
  content:"";

  top:8%;
  width:118%;
  height:150px;
  border-radius:50%;
  transform:rotate(28deg);
  transform-origin:center;

    radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 52%, rgba(235,250,255,.18) 0%, rgba(110,215,255,.11) 18%, rgba(120,145,255,.055) 38%, rgba(175,110,255,.025) 54%, transparent 73%);
  filter:blur(17px);
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
  opacity:.52;
}
.nexus-chat-milkyway::after{
  content:"";

  left:7%;
  top:20%;
  width:88%;
  height:4px;
  border-radius:50%;
  transform:rotate(28deg);
  transform-origin:right center;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(120,205,255,.025) 35%, rgba(185,235,255,.09) 67%, rgba(235,250,255,.20) 91%, transparent 100%);
  filter:blur(2.5px) drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(125,215,255,.10));

}
.nexus-chat-milkyway i{
  position:absolute;
  left:84%;
  top:46%;
  width:7px;
  height:7px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(245,252,255,.72);
  box-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(195,235,255,.34),0 0 18px rgba(110,205,255,.12);

}

</style>

<style id="nexus-ui-transparency-consolidated-v155">\n/* v0.5.155 CLEAN — 146〜154の透過調整をここへ一本化 */\n:root {\n  --ui-surface: rgba(22,31,49,.24);\n  --ui-line: rgba(83,215,255,.10);\n  --ui-text: rgba(215,241,250,.82);\n}\n\n/* 下部操作は背景上へ。黒い帯を作らない */\n.app { grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr) !important; padding-bottom:18px !important; }\n.main { padding-bottom:96px !important; }\n.input-area {\n  position:absolute !important;\n  left:clamp(12px,2.2vw,28px) !important;\n  right:clamp(12px,2.2vw,28px) !important;\n  bottom:18px !important;\n  z-index:20 !important;\n  background:transparent !important;\n  box-shadow:none !important;\n}\n.input-area, .quick, .composer, .console-head { background:transparent !important; }\n\n/* チャット欄を基準にUI面・輪郭・文字を統一 */\n.quick button, .tool-btn, .task-restore, .typing-status, .pill,\n.task-panel, .task-card, .route-chip, details, details > summary,\n.detail, .details, .detail-panel, .detail-box, .detail-card, [class*="detail" i] {\n  background:var(--ui-surface) !important;\n  border-color:var(--ui-line) !important;\n  box-shadow:none !important;\n  text-shadow:none !important;\n}\n\n.quick button, .tool-btn, .task-restore, .typing-status, .pill,\n.task-panel, .task-panel *, details, details > summary,\n.detail, .details, .detail-panel, .detail-box, .detail-card, [class*="detail" i] {\n  color:var(--ui-text) !important;\n}\n\n/* TASKの例外的な濃さを作らない */\n.task-panel .route-chip.active {\n  background:var(--ui-surface) !important;\n  border-color:var(--ui-line) !important;\n  color:var(--ui-text) !important;\n  box-shadow:none !important;\n  text-shadow:none !important;\n}\n\n/* 旧個別opacityを打ち消し、同じ基準値で描画 */\n.task-panel, .task-panel *, details, details > summary,\n.detail, .details, .detail-panel, .detail-box, .detail-card, [class*="detail" i] { opacity:1 !important; }\n\n/* 球体・リング・背景・彗星には一切指定しない */\n
/* v0.5.156-safe — レイアウト寸法は変更せず、下部の黒面だけ透明化 */
.input-area,
.quick,
.composer,
.console-head {
  background: transparent !important;
  background-color: transparent !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}


/* v0.5.158 — ボタン列と入力欄の間の境界線だけ削除 */
.composer {
  border-top: 0 !important;
  border-top-color: transparent !important;
}


/* v0.5.159 — TASK軌道上の白い粒だけ非表示。軌道線は維持 */
.nexus-task-orbit-decor .task-orbit::after {
  display: none !important;
  content: none !important;
}


/* v0.5.160 — 全UIを一段高透過化。背景演出は変更しない */
:root {
  --ui-surface: rgba(22,31,49,.13) !important;
  --ui-line: rgba(83,215,255,.055) !important;
  --ui-text: rgba(215,241,250,.68) !important;
}

/* v0.6.15 — reset to Plus-handoff.
   Cause: the ring scene is clipped at .main, while .input-area occupies a bottom row.
   Fix: let .main/holo render behind the fixed transparent chat controls. */
